fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Several high-traffic pages (`/tournaments/`, `/competitions/`, `/competitions/<id>/`, `/cards/<name>/`, and `/people/<id>/`) had no OpenGraph metadata. When shared on Discord or other social platforms, these links rendered with no title or description preview — just a bare URL.

## What changed

Added `og_title()` and `og_description()` methods to five view classes, following the same pattern already established in `decksite/views/archetype.py`:

- `decksite/views/tournaments.py`: title = `'Cardhoarder Tournaments'`, description = brief blurb
- `decksite/views/competitions.py`: title = `'Competitions'`, description = brief blurb
- `decksite/views/competition.py`: title = competition name, description = `'Penny Dreadful <type>: <name>'`
- `decksite/views/card.py`: title = card display name, description = `'<name> in Penny Dreadful'`
- `decksite/views/person.py`: title = person name, description = `'<name> on Penny Dreadful'`

The existing `header.mustache` template already conditionally renders `<meta property="og:*">` tags when `og_title` is truthy — no template changes required.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit decksite/views/` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (the skip is pre-existing and unrelated)

Fixes #5066
